system.description:
When you flash back to a time you made preparations, answer the following questions, and roll the dice.

  • Did you have plenty of time to do it?

  • Did you have someone looking out for trouble?

success.value:
Choose one option from the following list. Mark a condition, or the MC will tell you how your plotting is flawed or got you caught up in another problem.

  • You have fabricated a piece of evidence; tell us what it is.

  • You arranged for somebody to be in the right place at the right time.

  • You stowed away something hidden.

partial.value:
Choose one option from the following list.

  • You have fabricated a piece of evidence; tell us what it is.

  • You arranged for somebody to be in the right place at the right time.

  • You stowed away something hidden.

failure.label: Miss
failure.value:
Choose one option from the following list anyway, but the MC says who was lurking in the background and what they did to interfere before the flashback ends.

  • You have fabricated a piece of evidence; tell us what it is.

  • You arranged for somebody to be in the right place at the right time.

  • You stowed away something hidden.
